routing_warnings.description: The message reports that the invitation acceptance endpoint is not called and invited users have no landing route.
The message reports that the backend functionality required for the account member list does not exist.
The message reports that the backend functionality required for member revoke actions does not exist.
The message reports that the backend functionality required for member removal does not exist.
The message reports that member usage breakdown is available only to superadmins and not account owners.
The message reports that individual usage limits are available only to superadmins and not account owners.
The message reports that disconnect endpoints return success without deleting the connection record, contradicting instant revocation.
The separate finding about disconnect endpoints retaining connection records concerns connector access revocation, not account-member access revocation.
The separate finding that invitation links have no landing route belongs to the dedicated invitation landing-route Requirement.
The missing POST /account/users/accept call concerns invitation acceptance submission rather than the landing-route Requirement.
The missing member-list endpoint concerns the independent account-member-list Requirement.
The missing member revoke endpoint concerns the independent member-access-revocation Requirement.
The missing member removal endpoint concerns the independent account-member-removal Requirement.

The clauses stating that the disconnect endpoints report success without revocation and that the front end refuses to report success also provide evidence for the separate disconnect-success-reporting Requirement.
